topic: Write a Reflection on Improving Yourself(写一篇关于完善自己的反思)
title_en: How I Changed a Bad Habit
genre: 反思 / 记叙(describe a habit you改掉了 + what you learnt)
source: 外研社版选择性必修第二册 Unit 2 Presenting ideas / Writing a reflection:reflect on an experience of improving yourself(描述你改掉的一个坏习惯或养成的好习惯,以及从中学到的东西)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华。学校英语周刊正在征集'完善自己'主题的短文。请用英语写一篇约90词的反思,内容包括:① 描述你曾经的一个坏习惯(如熬夜刷手机、拖延、乱发脾气);② 你是怎样一步步改掉它的;③ 你从中学到了什么。注意:在合适处使用过去完成被动语态(had been done)。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your school's English weekly is collecting short pieces on the theme 'Improving Yourself'. Write a reflection (about 90 words) including: 1) a bad habit you used to have (e.g. using your phone late at night, putting things off, losing your temper); 2) how you changed it step by step; 3) what you learnt from the experience. Use the past perfect passive (had been done) where it fits.
points: 描述坏习惯(I used to … / My biggest problem was …)
改变过程(So I decided to … / Step by step, I …)
用过去完成被动(Before …, my time had been wasted on …)
收获与感悟(I learnt that … / Now I feel …)
model_essay: I used to spend hours on my phone every night, and my homework was often left until the last minute. Before I made a change, much of my evening had been wasted on social media. So I decided to switch off my phone and put it in another room while I studied. The first days were hard, but step by step the habit was broken. By the end of the term, my marks had been raised and I felt calmer. I learnt that small daily efforts can truly improve who you are.
model_translation: 我以前每晚要在手机上花好几个小时,作业常常拖到最后一刻才做。在我做出改变之前,我的晚上有很大一部分都浪费在了社交媒体上。于是我决定学习时把手机关掉、放到另一个房间。最初几天很难,但一步一步地,这个习惯被改掉了。到学期末,我的成绩提高了,人也更平静了。我明白了:每天一点点的努力,真的能让你变得更好。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:描述坏习惯 / 改变过程 / 收获感悟
围绕一个习惯展开、过程有条理、句句相关、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、过去完成被动(had been done)运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 描述坏习惯 I used to … / My homework was often left …
用过去完成被动 Before I made a change, … had been wasted …
改变过程 So I decided to … step by step …
收获 I learnt that small daily efforts can improve who you are.
key_expressions: I used to spend hours on my phone every night.
Before I made a change, much of my evening had been wasted on social media.
Step by step, the habit was broken.
I learnt that small daily efforts can truly improve who you are.

high_sentences: Before I made a change, much of my evening had been wasted on social media.
I decided to switch off my phone and put it in another room while I studied.
Step by step, the bad habit was broken.
I learnt that small daily efforts can truly improve who you are.

error_pairs.wrong: Before I changed, my time had wasted on my phone.
error_pairs.correct: Before I changed, my time had been wasted on my phone.
error_pairs.note: time 是被浪费的,主语是承受者,要用 had been done。

error_pairs.wrong: My homework was often leave until the last minute.
error_pairs.correct: My homework was often left until the last minute.
error_pairs.note: 被动语态用过去分词 left,不用动词原形。

error_pairs.wrong: I used to spending hours on my phone.
error_pairs.correct: I used to spend hours on my phone.
error_pairs.note: used to do sth 后接动词原形。

paragraph_template:
【完善自己·反思结构】
第1句 坏习惯:I used to … / My homework was often left …
第2句 过去完成被动:Before I made a change, … had been wasted/broken …
第3-4句 过程:So I decided to … Step by step, the habit was broken.
第5句 收获:I learnt that small daily efforts can improve who you are.
